entities.name: Ushanti
entities.description: Leonin seer and healer of Mirrodin, advisor to the kha Raksha Golden Cub.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Leonin kha of Taj-Nar; Ushanti's advisor; lover of her daughter Rishan.

entities.name: Rishan
entities.description: Ushanti's daughter, Raksha's lover, killed in a Leveler attack.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: Leonin city from which Ushanti was banished.

entities.name: Green Sun
entities.description: Sun released from the Radix, whose release Ushanti saw portents about.

entities.name: Radix
entities.description: Source from which the Green Sun was released.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event during which Ushanti disappeared from Mirrodin.

events.summary: Ushanti sees portents of doom after the Green Sun is released from the Radix.
events.quote: She saw portents of doom after the Green Sun was released from the Radix.

events.summary: Rishan is killed in a Leveler attack; Raksha, suspecting Ushanti, banishes her from Taj-Nar.
events.quote: Raksha had her banished from Taj-Nar

events.summary: Ushanti disappears from Mirrodin during the Vanishing.
events.quote: Ushanti disappeared from Mirrodin during the Vanishing

relations.quote: She was also advisor to the kha
Ushanti's daughter Rishan became Raksha's lover
